message.content: {"count":3,"rationale":"Block mailClient:execution, tokenCache:credentialAccess, and browserStore:credentialAccess. This disables vpnSession and rdpLogin, as well as apiToken and ssoLogin; consequently all four parents of the target become unreachable. Three blocks are necessary because there are three attack derivations with disjoint blockable steps: (1) browserStore → fileServer → codeRepo; (2) containerHost → tokenCache → printServer → mailArchive; (3) dmzWeb and mailClient → rdpLogin, together with kerberoast → backupHost, then hypervisor → dbReplica. Each derivation is supported by entry footholds and requires a separate block."}
